title: In accordance with the provisions of M.G.L. c. 25, sec. 18, the Department of Public Utilities hereby makes assessments against the following companies, in an amount not to exceed $50,000 per nuclear power plant, to be used by the Department of Public Health for the purpose of monitoring, surveying, and inspecting nuclear power plants in Massachusetts, as outlined in M.G.L. c. 111, sec. 5K. These assessments are based on actual costs incurred by the Department of Public Health during fiscal year 1990, documentation of which is on file at the Department of Public Utilities.
